study.question: Does removing complete private residual branches or a hidden affine/Dice stage for the two auxiliary tasks without shared context ownership preserve the current click AUC and reduce measured four-output prediction cost, beyond merely narrowing those branches?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g2-r0040-joint_owner_capacity_keep_buy and g2-r0041-joint_adapter_keep_buy retain click AUC 0.6671669182126774 while dense parameters decline 292661 -> 229749 -> 212533. Yet latest width reduction gives inference25.88055s versus reference25.68053s, p50 15.24588ms versus15.19273ms, and training324.48s versus315.27s (host receipt values govern exact comparisons). Cart/fav AUC falls from 0.75465/0.72491 to0.66509/0.68967. Thus parameter reduction alone has not established efficiency. Hypothesis: eliminating whole private stages removes kernel and activation work that narrow matrices still incur, with limited effect on click because cart/fav representation gradients are blocked. This is a bounded utility experiment on existing information flow, not a new unified architecture or a proof of independence. Global dense gradient clipping remains an indirect coupling.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text, sections4.2/4.3 inspected: inherit target-conditioned local activation, field embeddings and MLP/Dice lineage. Change only private task adapter presence and tower depth in the local compressed four-task descendant, not DIN attention or its original training claims. No priority claim.

Pinned primary implementation constructor/forward inspected (lines29-170): task-specific hubs and MLP towers provide the nearest inspected task-aware structural comparison. No hub/token/routing component is adopted; original paper:infnet full text is unavailable through this registry, so original-method equivalence and novelty remain unverified.

Closest local executable comparison. Inherit the complete template, all representations and source gradient gates. Replace width-only pruning with fixed removal of cart/fav adapters and/or their second hidden affine/Dice stage; use the complete two-factor suite to separate the changes.

inherited_components: Field/action embeddings and official historical task masks
Ten-block history compression, uniform primary readout, feedback-stratified auxiliary readout, all five ordinal/match residual signals
Attached rotated-duplicate normalization support during training
Task-specific residual routing, click residual14, buy residual10, cart/fav residual2 template
Click tower[128,64], buy[112,64], cart/fav[48,32] parent widths
Buy-only auxiliary context gradient ownership and fixed item/scorer auxiliary detach gates
Merged-hoist evaluation affine and factored evaluation Dice; common full-template initialization before pruning
study.proposed_difference: 2x2 factorial: private residual retained/removed x private tower depth2/1. Only cart/fav branches are eligible. Adapter removal deletes Parameter storage before optimizer construction and bypasses unused signal concatenations; it leaves the feedback-pooled base active. Depth1 retains the first48-channel affine/Dice and the original full template output first48 coefficients, discarding the second affine/Dice. Click/buy modules and all shared computation are unchanged. Baseline cell follows parent execution; all variants share executable source except literal CONFIG. All four outputs and losses remain trainable. This is training from scratch, with no source caching, labels in forward, checkpoint pruning, or host modifications.
predictions: Freeze before host screening: preservation requires validation click AUC >=0.6670669182126774 (current reference minus0.0001), paired difference versus fresh joint_stage_reference >=-0.0001, and AUC>=0.666653547526167 (entry reference minus0.0001). No threshold is relaxed after outcomes. A fresh reference mismatch beyond0.000001 triggers execution audit before interpreting causal effects.

Utility requires lower total and dense parameters AND host model-only p50 latency at least2% lower than fresh reference, p95 no worse by>2%, and end-to-end validation inference seconds at least2% lower under matched batch/device conditions. Training wall time is reported separately and may not regress>5% for a training-and-prediction efficiency claim. A single pass can screen only; require repeated authorized matched timing before an efficiency conclusion.

Expected dense counts are212533/208005/209365/204837 for reference/no-residual/shallow/both. Adapter removal eliminates two Linear-ReLU-Linear calls and their private residual inputs; shallow removal eliminates two affine/Dice stages. Total parameters remain embedding-dominated, so whole-model speed gains may be below the utility threshold.

Click and buy predictions may remain equal under the frozen seed, but no mathematical trajectory equality is assumed because dense clipping spans tasks. Report buy AUC/Logloss plus cart/fav tradeoffs and mean AUC. An auxiliary AUC drop>0.01 from the fresh reference is flagged as substantial degradation and disqualifies any claim of four-task quality preservation, even if click-only utility passes.

Use all four factorial cells to estimate each simple effect and the difference of effects. Matching click under stage removal supports this source allocation at this configuration only; repeated seeds alone cannot establish the proposed latency mechanism.
falsifiers: Any candidate fails either absolute or paired predeclared click tolerance on full validation; repeated losses would reject that candidate utility, not all possible private capacity reductions.
Removed stages fail measured cost gates or gains disappear under matched timing repetition; fewer parameters alone do not support efficiency.
Auxiliary AUC/Logloss degrades: retain that negative finding and label any click preservation as click-only. No unified four-task preservation claim.

Baseline bridge differs or host detects nonfinite output, bad mask handling, changed current-action visibility, lost task gradients, altered shared initialization, wrong optimizer ownership, or data/protocol identity mismatch: stop interpretation and record a charged failed attempt.
alternative_explanations: Private loss gradients can change shared dense clipping scale even with all their upstream representation paths detached
Removing a hidden stage changes function, parameter count and initial logit scale together; retained template coefficients are not a capacity-matched or function-matched control
Runtime/load/cache noise and one optimization seed; same-seed bridges are not independent seed support
More aggressive private reduction may degrade auxiliary tasks, which cannot be hidden by click-only selection
Most inference cost may lie in shared embeddings/scorer/summary construction, so eliminating private kernels may have negligible effect

Prior embedding/scorer/whole-tower reductions lost click AUC (e.g. g2-r0024-joint_embedding12:0.66411118; g2-r0024-joint_scorer_half:0.66543686; g2-r0025-joint_tower_half:0.66545692); reductions are allocation-specific, not universally safe

All-context reduced-capacity g2-r0039-joint_context_capacity_small_all loses click relative to small_buy, and keep_cart/keep_fav replacement controls lose click; ownership rather than parameter count may explain preservation
